entities.summary: Caterina Cornaro, a notable figure in the history of Cyprus, associated with Lusignan Crusader Kingdom of Cyprus (1474–1489). Preceded by Venetian Takeover and Genoese. Their legacy influenced Ottoman forces besiege and capture Nicosia in a single assault.
